svg.text: signature detection (RT-DETRv2) · similarity (Siamese ResNet18) · FastAPI + Redis + Celery on EC2 · continuous training on Kaggle
EC2 t3.large · Ubuntu 24.04 · docker compose (4 containers)
No dataset is stored in AWS: ZIPs go Hugging Face → Kaggle. S3 holds models, aliases and small run records only. No AWS keys on EC2 (instance role).
